data.name: Dragon Ridge Valley
data.detailed_description:
A fantasy life—and a business of your own

Leave the modern world behind and begin again in Valeheart Village. Dragon Ridge Valley is a single-player cozy fantasy shopkeeping RPG where you can build a new life, grow a business, craft valuable goods, form relationships, and explore a beautiful—but dangerous—magical valley.

Build your business

Begin with a humble market stall and work toward owning a permanent shop. Acquire your business license, purchase your property, and expand your shop through multiple upgrade levels.

Manage limited business inventory, transfer products into storage, and decide which goods to stock. Products placed into your business appear visibly on your shelves and displays. Open during market hours, serve customers, collect copper, silver, and gold, and reinvest your earnings into larger businesses and new opportunities.

Find, craft, and stock your goods

Gather ingredients, grow crops, mine ore, forage, cook meals, craft equipment and jewelry, trade with merchants, and recover valuable items while adventuring.

Item quality affects the value of your goods, while magical jewelry can provide buffs, blessings, and other useful effects. Decide what to keep for yourself and what belongs on your shop shelves.

Live in Valeheart Village

Create your character, purchase homes, and become part of a living medieval fantasy community. Meet villagers with their own routines and stories, build friendships, pursue romance, and make choices that shape your relationships.

Explore beyond the market

Travel beyond Valeheart’s warm, lantern-lit streets into forests, mines, forgotten ruins, and dangerous underground locations. Hunt, fight hostile creatures, discover rare resources, and uncover the mysteries surrounding the dragons of the valley.

Key features

  • Own and operate a market stall and permanent shop

  • Manage business storage, limited stock, and shelf displays

  • Serve customers and earn copper, silver, and gold

  • Upgrade your shop and purchase additional properties

  • Craft, cook, farm, mine, forage, and trade

  • Discover items with different quality levels and magical effects

  • Build friendships and romantic relationships

  • Explore peaceful and dangerous fantasy regions

  • Customize your character and choose how to build your new life

Dragon Ridge Valley is actively being developed as a long-term solo passion project. Features, presentation, and content may continue to evolve as the valley grows.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains fantasy combat and violence (fighting orcs and other creatures). Enemies can be killed and looted. Violence is not intended to be graphic, with little to no gore, though limited blood and skeletal remains may appear in certain areas.
The game includes hunting/harvesting mechanics such as skinning animals for crafting materials.
The game also includes mild romantic content such as flirting and kissing, with occasional implied intimacy, but there is no nudity and no explicit sexual content.
Optional criminal activity may be present, such as stealing items from NPC homes and possible pickpocketing.
